nodes.name: Mockup Data
nodes.summary: JSON mockup data file for development and testing purposes.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON data file

nodes.name: App Styles
nodes.summary: Main application stylesheet with custom utility classes, responsive grid layouts, animations, component-specific styles for Navbar, Dashboard, Programs, and page transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: CSS with custom properties and responsive breakpoints

nodes.name: App Root Component
nodes.summary: Root application component with page routing via state management, login modal with overlay, search overlay, mobile navigation, chat widget, and AnimatePresence page transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion AnimatePresence

nodes.name: Navbar Component
nodes.summary: Top navigation bar with scroll-aware background opacity, logo, navigation links for home/programs/success stories/contact, login button, and search trigger.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with scroll event listener

nodes.name: Dashboard Component
nodes.summary: Full user dashboard with points display, booked tickets management with QR codes, profile settings panel, filterable event cards grid, and animated tab navigation between dashboard, tickets, and profile views.
nodes.languageNotes: Large React component with multiple tab views and AnimatePresence

nodes.name: Programs Component
nodes.summary: Programs hub component with NationalPrograms grid, EventsExplorer, pathway filter tabs, and animated content transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with AnimatePresence tab switching

nodes.name: Chat Widget Component
nodes.summary: Floating chat assistant widget with toggle button, message history, input field with send functionality, auto-scroll, and animated open/close transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with scroll-into-view auto-scroll

nodes.name: Success Stories Component
nodes.summary: Success stories gallery with 12 stories data, filterable by pathway category, story detail viewer with expandable cards, quote highlights, and pathway-based navigation.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with AnimatePresence and filter logic

nodes.name: Contact Component
nodes.summary: Contact page with contact info cards (address, phone, email, working hours), inquiry form with validation, success notification, and interactive FAQ accordion.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with form state management

nodes.name: Hero Component
nodes.summary: Simple hero/banner section with search bar and filter button, importing filter options from data module.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with inline SVG icons

nodes.name: Footer Component
nodes.summary: Site footer with logo, navigation links, contact information, social media icons, newsletter subscription, and copyright notice.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with custom SVG social icons

nodes.name: Event Card Component
nodes.summary: Reusable event card displaying event title, date, location, pathway badge, point cost, and register button with hover effects.
nodes.languageNotes: React presentational component

nodes.name: Accessibility Widget
nodes.summary: Accessibility settings panel with font size controls, contrast mode toggle, and text-to-speech option.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion animations

nodes.name: Mobile Navigation Bar
nodes.summary: Bottom navigation bar for mobile with icons for home, programs, dashboard, profile, and chat, highlighting the active page.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with lucide-react icons

nodes.name: Search Overlay Component
nodes.summary: Full-screen search overlay with live filtering of allEvents by title/description, result cards with registration action, and animated open/close.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with AnimatePresence and live search

nodes.name: Sanad Modal Component
nodes.summary: Event registration confirmation modal branded as Sanad, displaying event details, ticket booking form, and confirmation action.
nodes.languageNotes: React modal component

nodes.name: Luxury Hero Section
nodes.summary: Premium hero banner for the home page with full-screen background image, gradient overlays, animated title text, subtitle, and CTA button.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion and inline background

nodes.name: Luxury Pathways Section
nodes.summary: Strategic pathways showcase with three pathway cards (Leadership, Economic Participation, Community Development), each with gradient icons, descriptions, and scroll-triggered animation.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with intersection observer animation

nodes.name: Ecosystem Programs Section
nodes.summary: Program ecosystem grid showcasing 12 program cards with icons, descriptions, and navigation to program details.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion grid animations

nodes.name: Home Events Section
nodes.summary: Events section with dual pathway/region filters, filterable events list from data, event detail drawer, and AnimatePresence list transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with animated drawers and event data

nodes.name: Pathway Wizard Modal
nodes.summary: AI-inspired step-by-step wizard modal with 3 questions to determine user interests, animated step transitions, and personalized pathway recommendation.
nodes.languageNotes: React multi-step wizard with Framer Motion AnimatePresence

nodes.name: Jordan Map Component
nodes.summary: Interactive SVG map of Jordan with clickable governorate regions for location-based event filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with inline SVG map paths

nodes.name: National Programs Grid
nodes.summary: Grid of national program cards with category filtering (all/tech/leadership/community), showing program logos, titles, and navigation to details.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with Framer Motion grid and tab filtering

nodes.name: Events Explorer Component
nodes.summary: Full events explorer with search input, pathway/location dropdown filters, interactive JordanMap, and results list with pagination-style layout.
nodes.languageNotes: React component with interactive map and multi-filter search

nodes.name: Event Details Drawer
nodes.summary: Slide-in drawer for event details with image hero, full description, date/location/points/age range metadata, pathway badge, and registration button using React Portal.
